assets.name: port
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium commercial editorial photograph for the hero of a Vietnamese logistics company website, landscape 21:9, approximately 2560 x 1100. A modern deep-water container terminal on a river estuary in southern Vietnam, soft cool early morning overcast light, subtle atmospheric haze, sophisticated steel-blue, slate-grey, white and deep burgundy palette. A physically plausible large unbranded container vessel is berthed along the RIGHT third of the frame, bow and hull clearly recognizable, ship-to-shore gantry cranes and orderly container stacks on the right. The LEFT 45 percent is calm dark blue-grey water and minimal pale misty sky, intentionally quiet negative space for an HTML headline. Elevated aerial editorial viewpoint, natural realistic perspective, crisply detailed cargo infrastructure, restrained high-end annual-report photography, NOT a digital illustration, realistic water texture and believable crane engineering. Ship and key cargo operations must remain legible when cropping to the rightmost 45 percent for a mobile portrait version. No text, logos, branding, watermarks, borders, collages, sunset orange, lens flare, over-saturated teal, fictitious corporate signage or fantasy machinery. No rendered UI. This is conceptual logistics imagery rather than an actual named company facility.
